title: Sewall.ai: a bounded, inspectable agentic harness over public biological data
description: Sewall.ai is a prototype of a federated, policy-aware, model-agnostic agentic data harness. A planner model, a scripted plan or an MCP host selects versioned scientific Skills over public NCBI metadata and Earth Engine summaries. A deterministic controller checks every action against the Skill registry, access policies and budgets, and writes a manifest that can be replayed and verified offline. It retrieves metadata and summaries only and establishes no biological finding.
